page.text:
The Defines: construct is used to specify an abstract concept, called a
type in other languages. To start, we specify that a set is an type.
We'll expand on it as we continue.

Here is the minimal content needed to define an abstract concept in
Mathlingua.

```mlg
[\set]
Defines: X
Documented:
. called: "set"
Id: "a0759217-e1f6-412c-982a-0038cd17a3a1"
```

The `\set` specifies the name used to identify this type. The `Defines:`
construct is used to define abstract concepts, i.e. types.

The `Id:` is used to specify a unique ID that identifies this item. Note
that you do not need to specify this ID manually. If you omit the `Id:`
section entirely and run `mlg check`, an `Id:` section with a new ID will
be automatically generated for you.
